meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 它立刻开始分析，不提问也不寒暄：对比代码与npm已发布版本，逐个查看未发布提交的差异，按三个层（omo pure components、omo opencode、omo codex）分类，并给出每层及总体的版本升级建议。
howto.when: 当对话中提到“unpublished changes”、“changelog”、“what changed”等触发词，或询问最新未发布改动时触发。

say.text: 列出当前所有未发布的更改，按发布层分组。
say.note: 会先对比npm最新版本，再输出分组结果。

say.text: 对比HEAD和最新已发布的npm版本，按层给出changelog。
say.note: 会生成分层影响矩阵和版本号建议。

say.text: 这次未发布的改动中，有哪些破坏性变更？
say.note: 会按层标注重大变更和建议版本号。

howto.what_en: It compares code with latest npm releases, reads real diffs behind each unpublished commit, groups changes by release layer (omo pure components, omo opencode, omo codex), and suggests a layer-specific plus overall version bump.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the conversation says 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', etc., or asks about latest unpublished changes.

say_en.text: List all unpublished changes, grouped by release layer.
say_en.note: It compares npm latest first, then outputs the groups.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with latest published npm versions and give a per-layer changelog.
say_en.note: Produces an impact matrix and version recommendations.

say_en.text: Which breaking changes are among these unpublished commits?
say_en.note: Marks breaking changes per layer and suggests bumps.
